svg.title: Ila compares a drainage application in her ledger with a hidden digital condition.
svg.desc: Ila holds her cracked phone beside the red ledger and points to the town's drainage request. Vale indicates the preselected integration clause as Ila observes that the box, not the council, accepted it.
svg.text: Page 5, panel 4 · Over-table medium shot on Ila comparing phone and ledger

text.tspan: Ila discovers that the old application accepted live
